guideline: Participants rated questions on a 5-point Likert scale across four dimensions before and after web searches

Participants assessed 450 randomly selected questions, evenly distributed across all types, using a 5-point Likert scale across four dimensions: (1) readability; (2) ease of answering prior to using a web search engine; (3) ease of answering after conducting a web search; and (4) overall clarity (including lack of ambiguity).
